propositions: The code-v3 impact model discards verifier-supplied prod_impact and trigger_likelihood fields for maint-lane findings, preventing blocking on consequential test-sufficiency gaps even when user-reach is high

Code review missed a contract-assertion contradiction (stale>0 allowed but test asserts stale=0) because tests findings are scored ~0.30 under v3 dampening (churn90 absent 80% of time) vs advisory threshold 0.95

The code-v4 redesign adds forbids_contract_allowed_state binary to Pass-2, re-scopes prod_impact/trigger_likelihood descriptions to capture guarded-path reach for maint findings (replacing test-only⇒none clause), and splits maint-lane binaries into serious (×1.0 undamped), moderate (× prod_impact mult), and debt (churn amplifier only)

Tests findings must flip from advisory to blocking@0.54 with v4 lane split and lane-scoped trigger maps; serious-maint and moderate-maint blocks now consume prod_impact; consequence-lane-only reversibility floor prevents debt binaries from falsely crossing threshold
Replay of v3 sidecars against v4 logic yields 99 changes block (8.0%, up from 42/3.4%) with zero demotions and no new validity-floor hazard; stored sidecars remain unwritten (version-gated)
